findings.title: C7 once_path cannot pass pinned v9 authority contract
findings.trigger: Any MODEL_TRIAL reaching C7 after successful Host qualification
findings.actual: Caller puts once file under receipts output with fixed c7-execute.once.json filename. v9 requires data_root/trial-once/<run_uuid>.json and an existing trial-once directory. Bootstrap v3 only creates trial-control.
findings.impact: C7 precheck fails after the qualification provider request; no ordinary model turn can run.
findings.minimal_fix: During provider-free setup create/validate the isolated data_root/trial-once directory; construct once_path with current run_uuid filename under that directory, leave the file absent until v9 consume_once. Freeze this exact path in basis/registration/grant; never delete or reset an existing once file.

findings.title: Content hash passed as qualification ArtifactRef hash
findings.trigger: After R01 is fixed, any valid qualification with different content and ArtifactRef digests
findings.actual: Host admitted.profile_hash derives from Artifact.content_hash. Domain runtime_bindings and runtime_qualification_runs store Hash(ArtifactRef), as v9 explicitly requires. Caller forwards the content hash into qualification_profile_hash.
findings.impact: v9 exact_qualification rejects valid completed qualification and wait_qualification retries that predicate until the shared deadline; ordinary requests remain unstarted.
findings.minimal_fix: Keep Host content-hash fields and GO contract unchanged. Populate C7 qualification_profile_hash from the exact actual ArtifactRef digest (engine.go_hash(profile_entity_ref)); before GO, read and cross-check that digest with the current project/runtime binding and admitted qualification marker. Preserve original profile byte hash separately.
